NeuroSync FPS Sensitivity Calibrator 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Automated FPS game sensitivity calibration tool for mobile, based on black-box system identification using control engineering theory.
- Achieves industrial-grade model fit ($R^2 = 0.97$) leveraging Python 3.11 with OpenCV, NumPy, and SciPy.
- Accepts 12 real measured in-game angle data points as input; outputs key tuning parameters including low-/high-speed system constants and physical sensitivity metrics.
- Built-in privacy protection: automatically masks sensitive UI/video regions to safeguard user accounts.
